Competitor swipe · paid entry captured 21 August 2026

Miss Affiliate — the whole business, wired

Nurse to $157k/month, sold to women. She went dark on Meta at the end of July and relaunched on 20 Aug with 18 ads — all pointing at a brand-new /signup slug we had never seen. Two funnels run behind two different pixels: a live-class ladder with two paid steps before the seat is even confirmed, and a separate VSL → application lane with a hard $2,000 budget floor.

Technique

How the answers are built

The honesty pledge buys permission to give a partly inconvenient answer, which makes the convenient half land harder.
Opener“I want to be honest”
Riskrelocated onto hesitating
Incomerefuses to promise
90 days3 process wins
Structureconcede, then reveal
Three different class days, ad vs page vs event

Six of the seven running creatives say “this Sunday at 3pm Eastern”. All 18 ads land on /signup, whose title tag reads “Next Wed 8pm ET”. The class she actually ran on 20 Aug was a Thursday 8pm ET, per her own WebinarJam mail. She is paying to promise a day her funnel contradicts on arrival, twice.

VERIFIED · 7 creatives transcribed, both page titles, and the WebinarJam reminder body, 21 Aug
Two pixels → two operators

/signup, /almostdone and /replay all carry pixel 2548125322312559 plus a Cortana hub. /start and /application carry 903499129224608 and no Cortana. Different pixel, different footer city. The Ad Library shows no ads at all pointing at funnel B, so whatever feeds it is not Meta.

VERIFIED · pixels read off live HTML, domain-wide Ad Library query 21 Aug
Declines the $27 VIP → a second paid offer

The decline path is monetised. Saying no to VIP routes to a separate replay-access offer, and only after declining that does the confirmation page appear. Two chances to convert on the highest-intent moment in the funnel.

VERIFIED · walked both decline paths 31 Jul
The $13 replay is now free on /replay

She sells replay access for $13 inside the confirmation ladder, then serves the entire 1h42m class unauthenticated on /replay to anyone with the URL. The paid step is a friction tax on the honest, not a gate.

VERIFIED · played 6,177s off the live page, no login, 21 Aug
The reminder sequence is untouched platform default

All 71 emails come from webinarinfo@webinarjam.net. Body is ~900 characters of class title, host name, room link and password. On 20 Aug it fired 45 times into one registration in two bursts, 22 copies of one mail in three minutes. Her biggest class of the month, 18 fresh ads behind it, and the follow-up is stock template sent twenty times over. The one place we are clearly ahead.

VERIFIED · 71 messages, 45 distinct message ids in the 20 Aug bursts
She attacks the UGC model by name, unprompted

Asked in Q&A how this compares to UGC, she says she started there at 18 or 19, then: “With UGC you're just paid for that one piece of content and you never get paid on the sales it makes. The brand just takes it from you.” One-off fee against residual. Same audience we sell to, and we have no answer to it on file.

VERIFIED · transcript 01:34:04–01:35:00
“Please don't apply unless you're serious”

The strongest move on the call. Applying becomes a favour to her, and the scarcity is framed as respect for other women waiting rather than her revenue. Raises perceived value and filters the list in one line, and never sounds like selling. Paired with two separate questions that extract a show-up promise in the prospect's own words before a call exists.

VERIFIED · close slides + Typeform Q8 and Q9
“I have no followers” → pre-approved accounts

She concedes TikTok's real 5,000-follower rule plainly, then reveals a “cheat code”: access to pre-approved accounts that already clear it, “ethically and safely”. The concession is what makes the reveal credible. Flag: account transfer sits against TikTok's terms. Copy the persuasion structure, not the mechanic.

VERIFIED · transcript of “Do I need followers”
“What's my risk?” → risk is inaction

“The real risk is not the program. The real risk is hesitating while one of the biggest opportunities in social media history is happening right in front of us.” She never defends price. She moves the risk onto standing still.

VERIFIED · transcript, 99-second answer
“How fast will I earn?” → no number given

“How much money will you make in 90 days? It's impossible to tell.” Then three process promises: confidence with the platform, first commissions in 60–90 days, and a durable skill. Legally clean and more believable than a figure.

VERIFIED · transcript of the 90-day answer
